battles-tip: Battles fought in this vehicle on this map.
rating-tip: Its rating over its battles on this map, with the site’s own formulas.
everywhere-tip: The same vehicle’s rating over every map of the mode.
gap-tip: Its rating on this map minus its rating on every map: above zero, the map suits it.
thin-row: Fewer than {count} players took this vehicle here, so these figures say more about them than about the vehicle on this map.
